title: Diver finds a breathing, organic object off Hawaii (David Noble White Crow account)

tellings.quote: Um this guy David Noble White Crow, cuz he's a he's Indian guy. Yeah. He was a UFO witness, but then he was stationed somewhere with this guy who apparently dove on an object in Hawaii.

plain: Sometime in the 1960s, a diver is said to have gone down on a strange object in the waters off Hawaii, an object later described as organic and seeming to breathe. Michels passes it on second-hand from a UFO witness named David Noble White Crow, whom he describes as Indian. White Crow was stationed somewhere with the man who apparently made the dive, and if the account holds, something alive or partly alive was lying on the seafloor.
